citation.authors: Callender VD, Baldwin H, Cook-Bolden FE et al

record.population: Patients with skin of colour (mixed groups)
record.design: Clinical review of topical retinoids for acne and dark marks
record.finding: Topical retinoids treat acne and have been shown to reduce dark marks in skin of colour, so should be started early unless contraindicated; moisturisers and novel formulations may cut irritation; acne spots improve weeks before the marks do.
record.note: Authors declare industry ties (conflict statement lists several manufacturers).
